alex: heads-up: internal scan (weekly-key-audit) flagged several DB snapshots written using AES256 not our CMEK. policy engine raised a compliance alert :warning:
mira: can you share the audit snippet?
alex: from audit log (redacted):
```
protoPayload.methodName: "storage.objects.insert"
resourceName: "projects/_/buckets/db-snapshots-prod/objects/mysql-2026-06-01.sql.gz"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "snapshot-upload@prod"
protoPayload.request.cmekKey: null
```
ben: snapshot-upload SA should have been using CMEK via grant. Any recent key rotations or grant expiries?
mira: we rotated the CMK two days ago and issued short-lived grants for the uploader (TTL=36h) during testing. Looks like one job ran after TTL expired.
alex: also noticed terraform drift: the backup module was rolled back to a legacy IAM binding granting storage.admin to snapshot-upload by a manual apply yesterday. That could bypass our bucket-level conditions.
ben: manual apply? who ran it? ops-bot, any deploy events around 1769990000-1769991111?
ops-bot: terraform apply: infra/modules/snapshots by ci/pipeline at 1769989805. Changes included: +google_storage_bucket_iam_binding.snapshot_uploader -> role: roles/storage.objectAdmin
sophia: that explains how uploads happened without CMEK enforcement in practice. The binding gives broad rights so the uploader didn't fail when kms:Encrypt denied it; it just uploaded with SSE-S3.
alex: immediate actions: 1) revoke the objectAdmin binding on snapshot-upload SA, 2) rotate any pipeline creds tied to that SA, 3) enumerate affected objects and mark for rewrap/quarantine.
mira: I'll run a BigQuery audit to list matching inserts in the last 72h. Suggested query:
```
SELECT protoPayload.resourceName, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp
FROM `org.logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName = "storage.objects.insert"
  AND json_extract_scalar(protoPayload.request, '$.cmekKey') IS NULL
  AND protoPayload.resourceName LIKE "%db-snapshots-prod%"
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR)
```
ben: long-term controls: (a) org-policy to require CMEK for buckets matching snapshot patterns, (b) CI lint to block terraform that assigns storage.objectAdmin to snapshot modules, (c) monitoring for grant TTL < 24h and auto-renew or fail the job.
sophia: small gotcha: our snapshotter sometimes uses signed URLs generated in a different service. If the signed URL generation service doesn't include the CMEK header, uploads will miss the key even if the SA has permissions. We need signed-url contract tests.
alex: good call. Add an e2e that uploads via signed URL and then checks audit record for cmekKey presence.
ops-bot: action: revoked iam binding at 1769991202. Also queued rotation of pipeline service token.
mira: scan results: found 7 objects in last 48h without cmek, 3 were large snapshots used by nightly restores — marking them `quarantine: true` and scheduling rewrap via copy+rewrite. Filing INC-2026-819.
ben: for rewrap we can use bucket-level rewrite (GCS) or S3 Batch copy depending on cloud. Add checksum verification after rewrap and annotate asset inventory.
sophia: runbook updates: encops-playbook.md -> add section "signed-url CMEK contract", "ephemeral-grant TTL detection", and a snippet for terraform lint rules. I'll open a PR.
security-bot: reminder: attach audit query results and evidence of re-encryption in incident before closing. Also flag for a postmortem if more than 5 objects affected.
alex: opening follow-up: require CI check that any terraform apply touching snapshot modules must include `condition: { "StringEquals": { "storage:x-goog-server-side-encryption": "projects/KEY_PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck" } }` or equivalent. Temporary mitigation: add a guardrail script to block applies that add storage.objectAdmin to snapshot modules.
mira: I'll coordinate with infra to land the guardrail and schedule the rewrap job. tagging infra: @ben
ben: acknowledged. I will also add a dashboard alert for KMS GrantCreate events that shows active grants and TTL. Notify owners 24h before expiry.
alex: thanks all. closing slack loop once INC-2026-819 has rewrap evidence :white_check_mark:
